method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.

method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.

method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.

method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.

method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.

contract: DP attention is enabled; global B=500 is distributed across eight local DP lanes.
Local real batches are four lanes of 63 and four lanes of 62; every physical CUDA graph runs B=63.
Each sequence returns one fake handoff token and one GPU-computed decode token.
No prefill work or speculative decoding belongs to the selected generation.
limitations: No module NVTX ranges label individual graph nodes; ownership is a validated reconstruction from kernel motifs and stream evidence.
Raw residency includes overlap and possible dependency-sensitive time; it is not critical-path or isolated arithmetic latency.
Batch padding is contract-derived. Standard server rows may expose the physical padded batch but do not prove real 62/63 rank assignment.
MFU/MBU are intentionally absent: this scaffold has no approved model FLOP or byte numerator for the new B=500 trace.
The detailed GPU0 tree is one representative physical B=63 replay; it is not the full B=500 timing boundary.
The complete four-wave DP8 capture is independent and not directly comparable with the native DP1 B=1 timing identity.
Graphless kernels are outside the audited full-model boundary and are not classified as cleanup.

method.boundary: The tree contains one complete representative GPU-0 graph-family-2 execution (correlation 72031). Global B=500 is distributed over DP8; this physical graph computes 63 local rows at 3,072 context tokens. It is not an eight-rank summed timeline.
method.ordering: Layer and branch ownership follows capture-local CUDA graph-node order and audited semantic anchors. GPU timestamps are used only for timing; asynchronous timestamps never determine logical adjacency.
method.timing: Active union merges overlapping intervals once on GPU 0; summed residency adds every kernel duration and therefore includes overlap; wall span is last end minus first start; idle gap is wall minus union.
method.aggregation: Operation rows aggregate disjoint layer branches. Their wall span is the measured first-to-last envelope across all included invocations, while active union excludes intervening idle intervals.
method.tail: The DP hidden-state gather is BF16 zero-fill + memcpy_triton + BF16 all_reduce_two_shot before the LM head. Only the post-LM-head NCCL operation is labeled the TP vocabulary AllGather.
method.utilization: No MFU/MBU values or FLOP/byte numerators are emitted. The final audit explicitly marks those quantities unavailable for this capture.
method.provenance: Every layer subtotal is replayed against the final audit's event count, category counts, marker counts, ordered-name fingerprint, and timing.

kernel_timing.non_comparable_reason: DP8 uses a four-wave eight-device envelope while native DP1 uses one GPU's active union. Context and topology also differ.

scope.rank_label: Representative GPU 0 physical graph; real 62/63 request assignment to a specific DP rank is not inferred

constants.utilization_model: not emitted; reviewed MFU/MBU numerators unavailable

method.boundary: The tree contains one complete representative GPU-0 graph-family-2 execution (correlation 72031). Global B=500 is distributed over DP8; this physical graph computes 63 local rows at 3,072 context tokens. It is not an eight-rank summed timeline.
method.ordering: Layer and branch ownership follows capture-local CUDA graph-node order and audited semantic anchors. GPU timestamps are used only for timing; asynchronous timestamps never determine logical adjacency.
method.timing: Active union merges overlapping intervals once on GPU 0; summed residency adds every kernel duration and therefore includes overlap; wall span is last end minus first start; idle gap is wall minus union.
method.aggregation: Operation rows aggregate disjoint layer branches. Their wall span is the measured first-to-last envelope across all included invocations, while active union excludes intervening idle intervals.
method.tail: The DP hidden-state gather is BF16 zero-fill + memcpy_triton + BF16 all_reduce_two_shot before the LM head. Only the post-LM-head NCCL operation is labeled the TP vocabulary AllGather.
method.utilization: No MFU/MBU values or FLOP/byte numerators are emitted. The final audit explicitly marks those quantities unavailable for this capture.
method.provenance: Every layer subtotal is replayed against the final audit's event count, category counts, marker counts, ordered-name fingerprint, and timing.
